name: Aptos Explorer
description: Official Aptos blockchain explorer. Agents should fetch HTML or markdown pages over HTTPS and use published URL templates; this host does not expose an A2A JSON-RPC task endpoint. Browser agents can use WebMCP tools registered on the page. Skills below describe how to open transactions, accounts, blocks, coins, search, and releases.

skills.name: Search Aptos Explorer
skills.description: Look up an opaque Aptos identifier (address, transaction version or hash, ANS .apt name, coin type, or block height) via /?search={query}. The explorer auto-detects the entity type.

skills.name: Open transaction
skills.description: Open /txn/{version} or /txn/{hash} for an Aptos user or system transaction, with optional detail tabs (userTxnOverview, events, payload, changes, balanceChange, trace).

skills.name: Open account
skills.description: Open /account/{address} for a 0x-prefixed account or ANS .apt name, with optional tabs (transactions, coins, tokens, resources, modules, multisig, info).

skills.name: Open block
skills.description: Open /block/{height} for an Aptos block and its transactions.

skills.name: Open coin
skills.description: Open /coin/{type} for a fully-qualified Move coin type such as 0x1::aptos_coin::AptosCoin.
examples: Show APT coin info on Aptos explorer

skills.name: Open releases hub
skills.description: Open /releases for network deployment status, AIPs, or SDK and tool releases (tabs: networks, aips, sdks).
examples: What is the current Aptos mainnet framework release?
